libraries.description: List of libextractor plugin names (e.g., 'jpeg', 'ogg', 'mp3') to use. Plugins without .so extension assumed.

use_only_specified_libraries.description: If true, disables the default extractor set and uses only the plugins listed in 'libraries'.

verbosity.description: Verbosity level (0 = quiet, 1 = standard, 2+ = more verbose).

include_keyword_types.description: List of keyword types to include in output. Use 'extract -L' to list all known types.

exclude_keyword_types.description: List of keyword types to exclude from output. Use 'extract -L' to list all known types.

in_process.description: If true, run extractor plugins in the main process (for debugging).

in_memory.description: If true, load files into memory before extraction (for debugging).
